Three, each earned by a mistake in this session rather than imagined.

PO-7. NEVER MEASURE A TREE YOU ARE STILL EDITING, or one somebody else is
editing. Commit, confirm clean, confirm HEAD has not moved, then run. Cost of
learning it: one twenty-two-minute run that reported a failure in working code.

PO-8. BEFORE DISPATCHING A WRITER LANE, CHECK WHETHER THE WORK ALREADY LANDED.
One log read would have saved twenty minutes and a killed agent. The claim
system deliberately cannot see across repositories, so this one is discipline
and says so.

PO-9. ASK THE CONTROL, DO NOT RE-DERIVE IT. A grep over the claim registry
would have reported twenty live claims; asking the hook returned twenty
refusals to enforce, which is the opposite conclusion and became a filed
finding.
